value.signature: async fn as_of (& mut self , scope : & EpochScope , tip : Identity , depth : u64) -> Result < Option < ServerResult > , Error >

review.body: { scope_check (scope) ? ; i64 :: try_from (depth) . map_err (| _ | StorageError :: Representation) ? ; let key = Self :: scope (scope) ? ; let key = key . text () ? ; let rows = self . request (Statement :: ReadEpoch , & [& key , & & tip [..]] , 1 , 278 , false) . await ? ; let tip = Header :: read (rows . first () . ok_or (Error :: MissingTip) ?) ? ; let ranges = self . ranges (key , & tip) . await ? ; let depth = depth . min (tip . depth) ; let Some (range) = ranges . iter () . find (| range | range . start <= depth && depth <= range . end) else { return Ok (None) ; } ; let ceiling = i64 :: try_from (depth) . map_err (| _ | StorageError :: Representation) ? ; let rows = self . request (Statement :: ReadEpochAsOf , & [& key , & & range . segment [..] , & ceiling] , 1 , 278 , false ,) . await ? ; let header = Header :: read (rows . first () . ok_or (StorageError :: CorruptHistory) ?) ? ; if header . segment != range . segment || header . depth != depth { return Err (StorageError :: CorruptHistory . into ()) ; } let result = self . reconstruct (scope , key , header) . await ? ; Ok (Some (result)) }
review.item_premise: The bounded server reader retains the existing protected Session and read-only transaction. Closed statements deliver only bounded public metadata and canonical retained evidence; all variable projections carry their stored lengths. The shared allowance admits delivery reservations, strict-validator requests and reconstruction before execution. Returned owned bytes and origins grant no admitted capability. Session configuration, cancellation and diagnostics retain their existing carriers; no new secret exit or transport path is introduced. Operation observation is outside reconstruction accounting.
